title: More 'My' Words: testvér, fiú, lány, gyerek

sections.content: Continue the 'my' pattern with sibling and child words. Most are regular: testvér → testvérem, gyerek → gyerekem, lány → lányom. fiú is an exception: fiam, not fiúm.
sections.title: Sibling words

sections.content: fiú breaks the pattern — the possessive is fiam, not the expected fiúm. It's one of the few irregular family words, so it's worth memorizing on its own.
testvér is built from test (body) and vér (blood) — literally 'body-and-blood,' the same idea as English 'blood relative.'
